subject: Cascading slot matrix + break splits for Alex Rivera (Full Loop)
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Cascading slot proposals for your virtual onsite (Alex Rivera)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the chat last week. We'd like to run a condensed virtual onsite (full loop) next Thursday 12/9. To keep things flexible for your schedule, we built a cascading-slot matrix with three multi-slot start times and small break splits so we can compress the day without interviewer overlap.

Proposed start windows (PST):
- Option A: 9:00am start — blocks: 9:00–10:30, 11:00–12:30, 1:00–2:30 (two 15m breaks)
- Option B: 11:00am start — blocks: 11:00–12:30, 1:00–2:30, 3:00–4:30
- Option C: 12:00pm start — blocks: 12:00–1:30, 2:00–3:30, 4:00–5:30

Each block contains two back-to-back interviews (75m total per block) with a short overlap for the shadow interviewer to capture notes and hand off context (we call this "pairing + shadow"). We can accommodate a single timezone preference — we defaulted to PST above.

If one of those start windows works, reply with your preferred option and any scheduling constraints (morning-only, must end by X time, or need a 30m lunch). Once you confirm I'll lock interviewers and send calendar invites. Attached is the agenda PDF and the internal pairing matrix we used to build the slots.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

---

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2026 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cascading slot proposals for your virtual onsite (Alex Rivera)

Thanks, Ben —

Appreciate the options. I can do Option B (11:00am start PST) but I have a hard stop at 4:30pm PST for another commitment. Also, I’m on Pacific and prefer a 30m break around 1:00pm if possible.

Also, I need one accommodation: could we make the coding exercise run-on with a 10m read window at the top so I can set up my environment?

—Alex

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2026 11:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cascading slot proposals for your virtual onsite (Alex Rivera)

Thanks Alex — Option B works given the hard stop. A couple of notes on sequencing so operations can set calendar invites cleanly:

- Block 1 (11:00–12:30): System Design (Marissa lead) + Product intuition follow-up (backup interviewer: Grace). 75m total with 5m handoff.
- 30m lunch buffer (12:30–1:00) to respect Alex's request.
- Block 2 (1:00–2:30): Coding exercise (Dylan lead) — schedule 10m read/setup, 60m coding, 5m debrief. Please ensure the coding doc link is in the invite and the environment read window is explicit.
- Short 15m break (2:30–2:45).
- Block 3 (3:00–4:30): Culture + Bar-raiser panel (Grace + Marissa) with a paired shadow interviewer for note capture (Tessa).

Tessa — can you create invites that show the 10m read window as part of the coding block, and add the Zoom + shared doc link? Also include the brief interviewer rubric in the invite attachments.

Dylan — can you confirm you can start at 1:00pm and be available through 2:30pm PST?

Marissa

---

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cascading slot proposals for your virtual onsite (Alex Rivera)

Quick note — I have an all-hands at 4pm that day and can’t be on panels after 3:30. Option B still OK (I can do 1:00–2:30), but I need the final panel to start no later than 3:00 and finish by 3:45 if possible. If that compresses the third block I’m happy to swap with Grace or have Marissa own the bar-raiser portion.

Happy to pair with Tessa for notes if that helps.

—Dylan

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cascading slot proposals for your virtual onsite (Alex Rivera)

All — I updated the agenda and pairing matrix (attached). Proposed small tweak to keep interviewer constraints intact and still respect Alex's hard stop:

- Block 1 (11:00–12:30): unchanged.
- Lunch (12:30–1:00).
- Block 2 (1:00–2:30): Dylan leads coding with the 10m read window.
- Short break (2:30–2:40) — shortened to 10m to absorb the compression.
- Block 3 (2:40–3:45): Culture + Bar-raiser (Grace & Marissa). This ends at 3:45 which fits Dylan's constraint.

I’ve attached "20261202_Alex_FullLoop_Agenda.pdf" (candidate-facing) and "panel_pairing_matrix.csv" (internal). Calendar invites will go out within 30 minutes once Ben confirms with Alex.

Attachments: 20261202_Alex_FullLoop_Agenda.pdf (application/pdf), panel_pairing_matrix.csv (text/csv)

Tessa

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2026 16:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Confirmed: Virtual onsite (11:00am PST start) — 12/9

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the quick reply and the accommodation note. We’ll run Option B (11:00am PST start) on Thursday 12/9 with the 30m lunch at 12:30 and the coding read-window included. The final block will end by 3:45pm PST.

Invites and the candidate-facing agenda are attached and the calendar invites have been sent from Greenhouse on our behalf — please accept when you get them. Zoom links and the shared coding doc are in the invites.

If anything changes to your availability please let me know ASAP. Looking forward to meeting you.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
